answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. The beacon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the grove is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a measured tone, citations in parentheses register, it stays short. The nadir of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
